headline: Universal Health Services Tops Q3 Profit and Sales Forecasts
summary: Hospital operator Universal Health Services reported third-quarter earnings per share that topped consensus by $0.02, alongside higher-than-expected revenue.
why: Universal Health Services operates acute care hospitals and behavioral health centers, serving as a key bellwether for US healthcare utilization and labor overhead.

impacts.name: Universal Health Services, Inc.
impacts.why: Third-quarter results surpassed expectations on both the top and bottom lines.
